title: Non-RFID spool runs out, auto-switch to a second spool of the same filament
notes: Spool 20 has 25 g and feeds the first 25% of a 100 g print, runs out; spool 21 (same filament) finishes it. Spool 20 must end at 0 g and Empty, spool 21 charged 75 g. Near-black 1A1A1A here; pure black is 07b. Runout model: the AMS reports the ran-out tray Empty with tag_uid/tray_uuid zeros and colour #00000000 (to confirm from a real runout); the active tray reads none while it switches.
